external_entities.name: colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague who signs in and uses applications.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.

external_entities.name: franchise colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague of a franchise store who signs in through the franchise identity provider.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them

external_entities.name: colleague's own device
external_entities.description: A device used by a colleague to sign in from home.
external_entities.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

external_entities.name: franchise identity provider
external_entities.description: An identity provider operated by the franchise that vouches for franchise colleagues.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The system from which group membership and leaver changes are pulled overnight.
external_entities.source_excerpt: it comes from the HR system overnight

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, validates federated sign-ins, and provides public signing keys.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that uses token groups to authorize price changes and transaction voids across stores.
processes.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A store holding the signing key used by the identity broker for tokens.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory of colleagues and their group memberships.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what that log records, whether it covers the franchise route

data_flows.name: sign-in
data_flows.description: A colleague signs in to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token to a signed-in colleague.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.notes: The token carries the colleague's staff id and a list of the groups they are in.
data_flows.data_description: staff id and group list in a token

data_flows.name: vouch for colleague
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for a franchise colleague to support sign-in.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them

data_flows.name: federated sign-in
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for a franchise colleague to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the broker takes that as a sign-in

data_flows.name: use console
data_flows.description: A colleague presents a token to the store admin console and changes prices or voids transactions.
data_flows.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions.
data_flows.data_description: token, price changes, and transaction voids

data_flows.name: use console
data_flows.description: A franchise colleague presents a token to the store admin console and uses its authorized functions.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications.
data_flows.notes: The text does not explicitly state that franchise colleagues use the store admin console; this flow represents the stated inclusion of franchise colleagues in the brokered application sign-in path.

data_flows.name: fetch public key
data_flows.description: The store admin console fetches the public half of the signing key from the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.
data_flows.data_description: public half of the token-signing key

data_flows.name: keep signing key
data_flows.description: The identity broker stores the token-signing key in the key store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_flows.name: update directory
data_flows.description: The identity broker maintains colleague and group membership records in its directory.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_flows.notes: Group membership changes are pulled from the HR system once a night.

data_flows.name: pull membership changes
data_flows.description: The identity broker pulls group membership and leaver changes from the HR system overnight.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night

data_flows.name: write sign-in
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes sign-in events to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_flows.notes: Nobody has written down whether it covers the franchise route.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: franchise stores
trust_boundaries.description: The environment controlled by the franchise stores and their identity provider.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.

trust_boundaries.name: home devices
trust_boundaries.description: The environment of colleagues' own devices used from home.

assumptions.assumption: The key store's contents are confidential because it holds a token-signing key.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the key store holds the broker's signing key.

assumptions.assumption: The directory's contents are confidential because it holds colleague identities and group memberships.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the directory holds colleagues and the groups they are in.

assumptions.assumption: The audit log's contents are confidential because it holds sign-in records associated with colleagues.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the audit log records sign-ins.
